--- PART 1/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report / "The given parent slot 8. Need improve." / "Parent scored 278.7, so there are conflicts and random defections."
STRATEGY: Parent is a cooperative TFT-like strategy with random defections when cooperation ratio is high. The trace simulates IPD matches against the 12-slot population and archive, analyzing payoffs and probing. It proposes removing random defections, adding an early probe to detect Always Cooperate, forgiving retaliation, and defecting on the final round.

--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report / "We can also avoid probing if we detect opponent is likely retaliator from their first move? They all start C, so no."
STRATEGY: The parent uses an adaptive strategy: cooperate first, probe with a defection, then alternate probe/cooperate while the opponent has never defected, switching to generous TFT with punishment for repeated defections once the opponent defects, and always defecting on the last round. The trace simulates this against TFT, Always C, Always D, and forgiving retaliators, and revises the probe schedule to defect at round 2, cooperate at round 3, defect at round 4, cooperate at round 5, then defect every round if the opponent still has never defected.

--- PART 3/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report / "Thus, I will design a strategy that never initiates defection." / "we should probably remove the proactive probe to maximize peer score."
STRATEGY: Parent is a TFT-like strategy with proactive probing and exploit mode; trace simulates it against population slots and archive; revision removes proactive defection, forgives single defections, defects on consecutive defections or high opponent defection rate, and defects on the last round.

--- PART 4/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Why did slot7 only score 282.99? Because slot7 itself has some aggressive rules (like the pattern punish) that might trigger against some opponents, causing conflicts."
STRATEGY: Parent (slot8) used proactive defection and scored 278.69; slot7 scored 282.99. The trace simulates the new strategy against slot7, slot0, and slot4, and changes the parent by removing proactive defection, using a very forgiving TFT with final-round defection.
